component.name: eFM
component.summary: Minimal player for internet radio streams

description.p: eFM is a small desktop player for internet radio streams (Icecast/Shoutcast, MP3/AAC/OGG/FLAC). Paste a stream address and press Play.

ul.li: Shows ICY metadata when the station sends it: artist, track, album, station name, genre and bitrate.
Remembers recently played stations and resumes the last stream on startup.
Reconnects on its own three seconds after a dropped connection.
